Subject: Corthan Table & Tap - Questions Before Quote

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the submission on Corthan Table & Tap! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good so far—this risk fits our appetite.

Before I can work up a quote, I need to clarify a few items:

- Do any locations have cooking operations? If yes, please confirm Type I hood and suppression systems are in place.
- What are the annual revenues for each location?
- Any locations serve alcohol past midnight?
- Current carrier and expiring premium?

Once I have these details, I'll turn around a competitive quote for the 12/12/26 effective date.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
